entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your arms flail about in a confusing pattern of strikes that trips and batters your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Dodge, Improved Trip, Octopus Focus, Octopus Style, Acrobatics 7 ranks, Perception 7 ranks.

Benefit(s): While using Octopus Style, when you threaten two enemies who are adjacent to each other, you can attempt a trip combat maneuver check against both targets at once in place of a melee attack. You attempt a single combat maneuver check at a –5 penalty and apply the result to both targets.
